text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2018.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 Januari 2018.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2018

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua puluh dua juta enam ratus enam

puluh ribu ringgit (RM22,660,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada Kumpulan Wang

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Skim Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2018 sebagaimana yang

diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 1,118,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 323,500

Perbelanjaan lain RM 6,218,500

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 15,000,000

Jumlah RM 22,660,000

Dibuat 24 Julai 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)744]

M. KULA SEGARAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1) of

the Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 January 2018.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2018

2. A sum not exceeding twenty-two million six hundred and sixty thousand ringgit

(RM22,660,000) shall be issued out of the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for

expenditure on the administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme for

the year 2018 as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 1,118,000

Supplies and services RM 323,500

Other expenditures RM 6,218,500

Landed properties, plants and equipment RM 15,000,000

__________________

Total RM 22,660,000

Made 24 July 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)744]

M. KULA SEGARAN

Minister of Human Resources
